name: manual_fad63c
claim: Require a reviewer to prove each finding before posting it: run wc -l and grep -n on the exact cited line and paste both outputs, and treat behaviour the ratified specification requires as not a finding.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: one reviewer cited line 1000 of a 323-line file, claimed a field was absent when it was present, and flagged spec-mandated behaviour; after the proof rule it retracted all six findings with evidence.

rationale: 2026-10-19: one reviewer cited line 1000 of a 323-line file, claimed a field was absent when it was present, and flagged spec-mandated behaviour; after the proof rule it retracted all six findings with evidence.
